notes: This source/test traceability contract covers only the bounded IEEE 1516.1-2025 region specification lifecycle in Umbra's opt-in, non-installable development profile. The profile creates private region templates from composed 1516.2-2025 dimensions (including a valid zero-dimensional template when the official createRegion DimensionHandleSet is empty), retains pending range updates until a complete commit, validates ranges against FOM dimension upper bounds, exposes the official support lookups, rejects deletion while a region is still used by a regional subscription, and deletes unused regions owned by the caller. A focused filesystem process-restart companion now restores one committed federation-owned region's owner, dimension set, and range bounds in a fresh registry; this is bounded state-image evidence, not complete region realization or DDM recovery. The sibling Python backend's InvalidRegionContext rejection for an empty createRegion set is intentionally not treated as a C++ requirement because the official 2025 C++ declaration omits that exception. Broader association/subscription overlap routing, timestamped/retraction behavior, remaining save/restore application ledgers, remote transport, package support, catalog evidence, and conformance remain outside this slice. The contract uses immutable candidate IDs exported by the Requirements Lab, including its current source-title path mismatch.
